text: आज बाज़ार में सब्ज़ियाँ बहुत महँगी थीं इसलिए मैंने सिर्फ़ टमाटर लिए
description: A woman in her forties speaks on a narrowband phone call. Median pitch about 210 Hz, a moderate pace of about 5 syllables per second. She pauses for about half a second after the first clause. A pressure-cooker whistle starts at about 2.5 s and she speaks louder from then on. She is telling a family member about her day.

text: நேற்று மழை பெய்ததால் நாங்கள் வீட்டிலேயே இருந்தோம்
description: A young man speaks close to a laptop microphone in a small tiled room with short bright reflections. A ceiling fan hums steadily in the background. He speaks slowly and evenly, with a falling pitch at the end of the sentence, as if explaining something patiently to a child.
